description: Land Acquisition - Kalametiya, Ambalanthota  D/S Division, Hambanthota District, Gurudeniya, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District and Rambuke Ela, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains orders for taking immediate possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition authority rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
